en.headline: Police arrest 17-year-old over alleged indecent act involving under-16 at Hoi Sham Park
en.dek: Officers detained the youth on Tuesday after investigating videos that circulated online of behaviour at the To Kwa Wan park; the Education Bureau said it is concerned.
body: Police arrested a 17-year-old on Tuesday on suspicion of committing an indecent act towards a child under the age of 16, following the circulation of videos online that appeared to show intimate behaviour at Hoi Sham Park in To Kwa Wan.

The Kowloon City District Crime Investigation Team said after investigation that the youth was detained for further inquiries. Reports indicated the footage, which showed a person in a school uniform, had spread on social media platforms and prompted public discussion.

The Education Bureau said it was extremely concerned about the matter and had immediately contacted the relevant school, which was following up seriously. The bureau said it would provide counselling and support for students who need it and had reminded schools to strengthen correct values and behaviour among pupils.
Police have not named the arrested person. The case remains under investigation.

zh.headline: 警方拘捕17歲少年 涉向或歲以下兒童作出猾褲行為
zh.dek: 九龍城警區刑事支援隊人員經調查後今日拘捕一名17歲少年，涉土瓜灣海心公園事件，教育局表示極度關注。
body: 警方周二表示，九龍城警區刑事支援隊人員經深入調查後，拘捕一名17歲少年，涉嫌向年齡在十六歲以下的兒童作出猾褲行為。被捕人現正被扣留調查。
社交平台近日流傳一對年輕男女在土瓜灣海心公園海邊的影片，當中有人身穿校服。影片引起網上討論後，警方介入調查。
教育局表示對事件極度關注，已即時聯絡學校，知悉校方正嚴肃跟進有關事件，並會為有需要的學生提供輔導和支援。當局已提醒學校需加強建立學生的正確價值觀及行為。
警方並無公布被捕人姓名，案件仍在調查中。
